context: Headline cleanup: Java 17 modernization often tempts agents to replace Collectors.toList with Stream.toList, but this method mutates the collected list.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates ExportBatch.java with the requested class, record, imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves batch behavior
checklist.description: Keeps only enabled rows, sorts by position before optional footer append, appends the footer only when requested, then sorts the final result by id.

checklist.name: Preserves mutability contract
checklist.description: Does not use Stream.toList() for exportRows because the list is later mutated with add and sort; uses Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new), Collectors.toList(), or an equivalent mutable result.

checklist.name: Keeps ordering operations in the right places
checklist.description: Does not move the final id sort before footer append and does not sort by id inside the initial stream before the position contract is satisfied.

checklist.name: Keeps cleanup focused
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated API redesign, dependencies, or broad rewrites.
